unit: Phase 6 core services and SDK v7 board
notes: Records the ten-unit Phase 6 board and dependency plan in docs/port/p6-launch-brief.md. Plan order: p6-001 library service; p6-002 import service; p6-003 Steam sync; p6-004 settings service; p6-005 metadata service; p6-006 notifications, dialogs and main-view API; p6-007 URI handler and HTML description service; p6-008 SDK Abstractions freeze and ApiCompat report; p6-009 sample plugins; p6-010 add-on manifest and installation model (store is v1.1). Dependencies: p6-001 first; p6-002, p6-004 and p6-005 on p6-001; p6-003 on p6-002 and p5-002; p6-006 on p6-001 and p5-007a; p6-007 on p5-005a and p6-005; p6-008 after p6-001..p6-007; p6-009 after p6-008; p6-010 after p6-009 and p3-005. Exit gate recorded in the brief: CLI import/list/search/launch dry-run without UI; Abstractions build plus reviewed ApiCompat report plus sample plugins compiling and loading; no Core reference to Avalonia directly or transitively; fake-host contract tests for every SDK interface. This PR owns only the p6-shards namespace, so it appends the board instead of creating or rewriting the p6-001..p6-010 rows; each unit PR carries its own row and fragment because the guards allow one unit namespace per PR. The seeded p6-001..p6-005 rows predate the plan and are redefined by their own PRs. No product code, test, protected oracle, baseline or generated aggregate is changed.
